messages:
Alisha: FYI customer tenant-42 started getting 504s around 10:14 UTC. They report heavy burst, timeouts from hosted API, and support flagged it as an escalated outage to SRE.
ops-bot: 🚨 Alert: gateway-5xx-rate spike for tenant-42 (10:14 UTC) — 120 5xx in 3m, avg latency 1.8s.
Samir: I'm seeing a large queuing backlog in front end, looks like scale didn't keep up. Can you share the tenant's scaledobject?
Alisha: Pasting scaledobject annotations they used in onboarding: 
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: tenant-42-scaledobj
  annotations:
    autoscaling.keda.sh/polling-interval: "30"
    autoscaling.keda.sh/cooldown-period: "30"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: tenant-42-deployment
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 10
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prom:9090
      metricName: tenant_queue_length
      threshold: "50"
```
Marta: minReplicaCount=0 + polling=30s + cooldown=30s is risky for sudden bursts. Also their readiness probe looks strict (startupProbe 5s timeout).
Lee: Looking at KEDA operator logs around 10:12: 
```
I0310 10:12:08 keda-controller ... ScaledObject tenant-42: queue len 120 -> scale up needed
I0310 10:12:08 keda-controller ... Trigger activate -> creating HPA with target 3
I0310 10:12:38 keda-controller ... HPA scaled, but pods not Ready: startup probe failures
I0310 10:13:10 kubelet ... Failed to create pod sandbox: image pull backoff (transient)
```
Alisha: Customer says they saw a timeout at 10:16 and retries still 504. They expect faster warmup.
Samir: Two obvious things: (1) image pull/backoff delaying pod start, (2) minReplicaCount=0 means coldstart. For hosted inference we usually recommend minReplicaCount >= 1 for high-SLA tenants.
Marta: Also their container cmd does a heavy model init on startup (1.2GB download + quant table build). That amplifies startupProbe failures.
Lee: Repro steps I ran:
- POST to /v1/generate 100 concurrent requests to tenant-42 route
- Observe HPA/KEDA create and pods pending for ~45s
- Requests hit gateway -> 504 at ~30s mark
Logs show kubelet image pulls then container start then model init ~70s.
Alisha: Customer asked for workaround while we investigate. Suggested we try manual scale?
Samir: Workaround: kubectl scale deployment tenant-42-deployment --replicas=3 && touch a readiness endpoint to keep it warm. That immediately dropped 5xxs. I did it at 10:28 and 5xxs dropped to 2/min.
Marta: Longer term: recommend tenant change scaledobject to minReplicaCount: 1 and increase polling-interval to 10s and cooldown to 120s OR add a warmup pre-provisioner. Also improve startupProbe to allow longer init: timeoutSeconds: 120 and initialDelaySeconds: 5.
Lee: On infra side we should: (A) add an autoscale policy that pins critical tenants to keep warm replicas, (B) add image pull metrics to KEDA trigger so we can pre-pull images when queue rises.
Alisha: Ticket update to customer: applied manual scale, reduced errors, investigating root cause (image pull + coldstart + strict probes). Will propose config changes and a patch.
Samir: Quick patch I pushed to staging: scaledobject controller will annotate scaledDownCooldown=60s for tenants with SLAs flagged. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/keda-autoscale/pulls/412
Marta: Also filing a runbook entry for this pattern: "burst + coldstart + image-pull -> gateway 504" with playbook steps (manual scale, increase minReplicaCount, adjust probes, check image registry).
Lee: Ops tasks: 1) Reach out to registry team to see transient pulls at 10:12 2) Add synthetic warmup traffic to tenant onboarding script 3) Consider defaulting minReplicaCount to 1 for paid tiers.
Alisha: Customer confirmed partial recovery. They're okay with patch but asked for SLA mitigation plan. I'll assign follow-ups.
Samir: For immediate prevention: I created a policy in the console that pins minReplicas=1 for tenant-42 and similar tenants for 24h. Monitoring will auto-remove after 24h.
Marta: Note for eng-runtime: we should add a lightweight model bootstrap path that returns 503 quickly for short-lived requests instead of blocking main worker init. Improves graceful degradation.
Alisha: Summary -> Root cause: combination of minReplicaCount=0 (coldstart), slow image/model init, and strict startupProbe causing pod not ready while KEDA/HPA scaled up. Customer impact: gateway 504/timeouts during burst. Mitigation: manual scale, console policy pin, change scaledobject annotations, patch startupProbe. Next steps: PR review, runbook, registry follow-up, and customer SLA plan.
Lee: I'll create a postmortem skeleton and link logs. Assigning owners: Samir -> infra patch, Marta -> runbook, Alisha -> customer comms.
Alisha: Thanks all. I'll close the escalation once PR deploys and we confirm stable. :thumbsup:
